metadata.name: sustain
metadata.description: 24h sustain benchmark for the Zouroboros healer fallback chain. Hybrid runner: --mode=synthetic compresses 24h into seconds via mocked clock for CI; --mode=wall-clock issues real /zo/ask calls at the configured cadence for the configured duration. Tracks drift (last-hour vs first-hour pass rate) and rolling p95 latency per tier. Run fails if total failure rate exceeds the budget.
metadata.purpose: Q2 #5 §3.9 family (b) Cycle B — verifies that fallback-rung fidelity holds across time, not just per-call. Catches accumulating-state bugs (the demo trading stale-bundle / World Monitor incident class), provider rate-limit windows, midnight quota rollovers, and slow degradation invisible to per-call benchmarks.
